title: ART, DEX, Class Loading, JIT, AOT, and Profiles

scout.purpose: Master art, dex, class loading, jit, aot, and profiles through a production or platform contract supported by causal evidence.
scout.realWorldUse: Android experts need to connect runtime, memory, power, and diagnostic evidence to the actual platform owner and recovery behavior.
scout.outcome: You can design, inspect, test, release, and defend art, dex, class loading, jit, aot, and profiles.

blocks.text: Kotlin and Java sources become class files and then DEX bytecode packaged into the application. ART verifies and loads classes through a hierarchy of class loaders, resolves references, interprets code, and executes compiled machine code. Since Android 7, devices combine interpretation, JIT, and profile-guided AOT rather than compiling every method identically. Install source, compiler filter, cloud or local profiles, idle maintenance, OS version, and app use shape the code state.

blocks.text: Class identity includes both class name and defining loader; duplicate libraries across loaders can fail casts despite matching names. Initialization runs static initializers once per class and can block the requesting thread. JIT observes hot methods and records profiles; dex2oat can compile profile-selected code. Baseline Profiles provide likely critical methods before enough local use exists. R8 changes program structure before ART and mapping is needed for diagnosis, but R8 is not the runtime compiler.

blocks.text: Use Macrobenchmark compilation modes, dumpsys package dexopt, simpleperf or Perfetto, and matching AOSP documentation to compare interpreted, JIT-warmed, and profile-compiled behavior. Do not infer device-wide policy from one build. Test dynamic features, custom loaders only where justified, profile installation, app update, data clear, and secondary DEX. Optimise startup and hot paths with measured profiles while preserving class-loader compatibility, mapping artifacts, and correct fallback when compilation state differs.

Internals knowledge is useful when it connects a user-visible symptom to the correct owner without turning private implementation into an app dependency. Record the Android build, device, process and compilation state, workload, command or trace configuration, and artifact identity. Combine matching AOSP source with runtime evidence and a controlled intervention. Distinguish managed from native memory, app from system policy, and snapshots from timelines. Test death, pressure, cancellation, idle policy, version differences, and recovery. Preserve the raw evidence and uncertainty. Production applications still use supported APIs; platform changes require security, compatibility, boot, performance, testing, ownership, and rollback evidence.

trap_check.mistake: Calling ART an ahead-of-time-only runtime ignores interpretation, JIT, profile-guided compilation, install state, and device policy.
trap_check.why: It hides an ownership, compatibility, trust, lifecycle, or evidence gap that becomes costly outside the demonstration.
trap_check.fix: Make the disputed boundary explicit and add a representative negative or compatibility test plus operational response.

trap_check.mistake: Treating one successful device, client, model, platform build, or release as proof of the supported contract.
trap_check.why: Advanced Android ecosystems contain version, hardware, consumer, policy, and runtime variation.
trap_check.fix: Define the support matrix and verify exact artifacts across representative and adverse conditions.

challenge_intro.task: Compare one critical journey under no compilation, warm JIT, and Baseline Profile modes; document class-loading, code state, trace evidence, and release implications.
challenge_intro.successLooksLike: The work includes a minimal coherent implementation, exact evidence, support and threat boundaries, adverse testing, release operation, and recovery.

recall.answer: AOT compilation and class-loading optimisation for methods and classes identified by a profile rather than the entire app.

recall.prompt: What must accompany an expert Android artifact?
recall.answer: Exact source and build identity, supported versions, contracts, tests, measurements, security and privacy review, release evidence, owner, and recovery plan.
They prevent consumers and operators from treating an untested or impossible condition as a silent guarantee.
